Android only lets an app tap buttons or type inside other apps through the Accessibility service. Saathi uses it only while running an automation you started. It never reads passwords or OTPs, never bypasses security screens, and sends nothing off your device.

1. Tap "Open Accessibility settings".
2. Open Installed apps / Downloaded apps.
3. Choose Saathi AI and switch it on.
4. Come back to this screen — status should say connected.
On Android 13+ Android blocks accessibility for apps installed outside the Play Store. Open App info, tap the ⋮ menu and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then enable the service again.
Tap the button, then switch to any app within 5 seconds. Saathi lists the visible text it can see. It is shown here only and never stored or sent.

Package names differ by device and app version, so Saathi checks what is really installed. Third-party apps can change their screens at any time; if a step cannot be done reliably Saathi stops and tells you.

Open an app, open Android settings, scroll, go back/home, search, read visible UI, open the file picker.
Send a message, make a call, share content, delete, post. A dialog shows exactly what will happen; nothing runs until you press the confirm button.
Typing passwords, OTPs or PINs; banking or payment transactions; changing security credentials; bypassing CAPTCHA; disabling security controls.
The checks are keyword and action-type rules. They are a safety net, so they may sometimes block or ask about harmless steps. Calls only open the dialer — you press the call button yourself.
Used only to perform automations you start. Screen content is not stored, logged or uploaded.
Voice input uses the speech recognition service configured in Android. Depending on your device it may process audio online (e.g. Google). Saathi itself has no internet permission.
Commands are understood by local rules on your device. No AI service or account is required.
No analytics, no ads, no cloud storage. Workflows and history stay in app-private storage. Contacts are searched locally and never copied.
Messages, calls and sharing always ask first. Passwords, OTPs and payments are blocked.

Saathi AI is a privacy-first Android automation assistant. It understands Hindi and English commands with local rules, opens apps and settings, and runs workflows you build. Core features work offline and without any AI service.

Third-party apps (WhatsApp, Instagram, …) can change their screens, so UI automation may fail on some devices or versions. Saathi stops and reports the reason instead of pretending it worked. Android may also block starting apps from the background.
